library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyquant)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(rprojroot)
library(wesanderson)


library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

virome_met_dt <- merge(virome_dt, meta_dt, by = "sample_ID")
virome_met_dt$Date <- as.Date(virome_met_dt$Date, format = "%d-%m-%Y")

virome_met_dt$species <- gsub("^s__", "", virome_met_dt$species)

target_species <- c(
  "Rotavirus alphagastroenteritidis",
  "Betacoronavirus pandemicum",
  "Betapolyomavirus secuhominis",
  "Human mastadenovirus F",
  "Mamastrovirus melbournense",
  "Betapolyomavirus hominis",
  "Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae",
  "Human mastadenovirus A",
  "Lentivirus humimdef1",
  "Norovirus norwalkense",
  "Hepatovirus ahepa",
  "Human mastadenovirus B"
)


select_dt <- virome_met_dt %>%
  filter(species %in% target_species) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = Date) %>%
  group_by(sample_ID, Airport, Timepoint, species) %>%
  summarize(RPKMF = sum(RPKMF), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(species, Airport) %>%
  mutate(rel_ab = RPKMF / sum(RPKMF)) %>%
  ungroup()


sample_grid <- virome_met_dt %>%
  distinct(sample_ID, Airport, Date) %>%
  rename(Timepoint = Date) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(species = target_species)

detected_dt <- virome_met_dt %>%
  filter(species %in% target_species) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = Date) %>%
  group_by(sample_ID, Airport, Timepoint, species) %>%
  summarise(
    RPKMF = sum(RPKMF),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_dt <- sample_grid %>%
  left_join(
    detected_dt,
    by = c("sample_ID", "Airport", "Timepoint", "species")
  ) %>%
  mutate(RPKMF = replace_na(RPKMF, 0))


plot_dt <- plot_dt %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, Airport, species) %>%
  summarise(
    RPKMF = sum(RPKMF),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

movp <- plot_dt %>%
  mutate(
    species = gsub("Betapolyomavirus secuhominis", "JC polyomavirus", species),
    species = gsub("Mamastrovirus melbournense", "Astrovirus MLB1", species),
    species = gsub("Betapolyomavirus hominis", "BK polyomavirus", species),
    species = gsub("Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae", "Influenza A virus", species),
    species = gsub("Lentivirus humimdef1", "HIV-1", species),
    species = gsub("Norovirus norwalkense", "Noroviruses", species),
    species = gsub("Hepatovirus ahepa", "Hepatitis A virus", species),
    species = gsub("Betacoronavirus pandemicum", "SARS-CoV-2", species)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = Timepoint,
      y = RPKMF,
      colour = Airport,
      group = Airport
    )
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "2 months",
    date_labels = "%b-%y"
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "International" = "#185FA5",
      "Domestic" = "#6a994e"
    )
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~species, scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(
    x = "Sampling date",
    y = "RPKMF",
    colour = "Flight type"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey96", colour = "grey70"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey94"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

movp
